description: This file defines Pydantic models (schemas) for various components of a machine learning project, including user authentication, project management, dataset handling, preprocessing, model training, candidate evaluation, and inference. It serves as the data validation layer for the backend application.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for user registration requests, including email, name, and password.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for user login requests, including email and password.

classes.name: MeResponse
classes.description: Schema representing user profile information.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Schema for token response with access_token and token_type.

classes.name: ProjectCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new project with name and optional description.

classes.name: ProjectUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating project details, optional fields for name, description, status.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Full project schema including id, owner, status, timestamps.

classes.name: DatasetCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating datasets with name, description, and file type.

classes.name: Dataset
classes.description: Schema representing dataset details including schema JSON and storage info.

classes.name: PreprocessConfigCreate
classes.description: Configuration schema for preprocessing, including target and feature columns, steps, split ratios.

classes.name: PreprocessConfig
classes.description: Full preprocessing configuration, includes IDs, timestamps, and seed.

classes.name: PreprocessRunCreate
classes.description: Empty schema for creating a preprocess run.

classes.name: PreprocessRun
classes.description: Details about a preprocessing run, status, metrics, and artifact URIs.

classes.name: ModelDesignCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a model design with algorithm, objective, and hyperparameters.

classes.name: ModelDesign
classes.description: Complete model design schema with IDs, timestamps, and hyperparameters JSON.

classes.name: TrainRequest
classes.description: Schema referencing preprocess run ID for training.

classes.name: TrainingRun
classes.description: Details about a training process, including metrics, status, artifacts, and timestamps.

classes.name: FitEvaluateRequest
classes.description: Request schema for model fitting and evaluation thresholds.

classes.name: FitEvaluateResponse
classes.description: Response indicating whether model passed thresholds and recommendations.

classes.name: CandidateCreate
classes.description: Schema to create a candidate with optional notes.

classes.name: Candidate
classes.description: Candidate details including stage, timestamps, notes.

classes.name: CandidateUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating candidate stage.

classes.name: EvaluationRequest
classes.description: Request to evaluate models on a dataset split with thresholds.

classes.name: EvaluationRun
classes.description: Evaluation process details including metrics and report URI.

classes.name: PredictRequest
classes.description: Input schema for batch or single inference input.

classes.name: BatchPredictRequest
classes.description: Request schema for batch predictions on a dataset.

classes.name: InferenceResponse
classes.description: Details of inference output, latency, timestamps.

classes.name: Visualization
classes.description: Metadata about visualizations related to a project.
